q: What is the primary purpose of the Stores Accounts Code?

options.B: To fix the pay scales of stores staff
options.C: To prescribe the accounting procedure for stores transactions on Indian Railways
options.D: To lay down recruitment rules for the Stores Department

q: The Stores Accounts Code is issued under the authority of which body?
The Stores Accounts Code applies to which of the following?

options.C: All stores transactions on Indian Railways

q: Which officer heads the Stores Accounts office on a railway?
The Stores Accounts office functions under the overall control of whom?

options.C: The Financial Adviser and Chief Accounts Officer

q: Which department is responsible for the physical custody of railway stores?
Which department maintains the independent quantity accounts of stores?
The division of work between Stores and Accounts departments mainly ensures what?

options.A: An independent check on custody and accounting of stores

q: Which of the following is a duty of the Stores Accounts office?

options.A: Physical receipt of materials at depots

q: Pricing of issue notes is done by whom?
Which book is a quantity account maintained for each item of stores?
Which book records the value of stores received and issued?
Bin cards are maintained at depots by whom?
Numerical ledgers are posted from which documents?
Physical verification of stores is conducted by whom?
Which of the following is maintained by the Stores Accounts office?
The cost of stores issued to works is ultimately charged to what?
Surplus found on physical verification of stores is adjusted through which account?
Deficiency found on verification of stores is dealt with how?

options.B: Written off with competent sanction after enquiry

q: Which statement best describes the Stores and Accounts relationship?

options.D: Stores holds custody while Accounts keeps independent records

q: Goods received at a depot are first recorded in which document?
Materials issued from a depot are documented through which voucher?
Which class of stores includes consumables like coal and oil?
Tools and plant are classified as which type of stores?
Unserviceable stores awaiting disposal are generally termed what?
Stores transferred from one depot to another are recorded through which document?
Materials returned by works to stores are accounted as what?
Which account collects the cost of materials issued but not yet finally charged?
The audit of stores transactions by the Accounts Department is known as what?
Which authority audits railway accounts on behalf of Parliament?

options.D: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India

q: Stock verification reports are submitted to whom for disposal of differences?

options.C: The competent authority prescribed for write-off

q: Which of the following books is NOT maintained under the Stores Accounts Code?

options.A: A personal diary of the storekeeper

q: The priced ledger is balanced in terms of what?
Rates for pricing stores issues are generally based on what?

options.A: The market price on the day of issue
options.B: A fixed rate for ten years
options.D: The average cost of stock in hand

q: Which document supports the quantity received in a numerical ledger?
Who is responsible for the safe custody of stores at a depot?
Disposal of surplus stores is arranged by which department?
Sale proceeds of scrap are credited to which head?

options.D: The railway revenue or the head concerned

q: Which of these is a duty of the Stores Accounts office?
Inspection of materials before acceptance is the responsibility of whom?
Which principle requires that every stores transaction be recorded promptly?
The Stores Accounts Code is one of the codes forming which larger set?
Monthly accounts of stores transactions are compiled by whom?
Which officer sanctions write-off of stores losses within delegated powers?

options.D: The competent authority under the Schedule of Powers

q: Fraud or loss of stores coming to notice must be reported to whom?
Which record shows the quantity of each item lying in a bin?
The numerical ledger balance should agree with which of the following?

options.B: The physical stock and the bin card balance

q: Which department prepares indents for procurement of stores?

options.B: The consuming department through the Stores Department

q: Purchase bills for stores are passed for payment by whom?
The ultimate object of stores accounting is to ensure what?

options.D: Correct charge of stores cost and safeguard against loss
